reuse.why: setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the N-month averages get the flag through the existing getBulkBudgetCategories/setBulkNMonthAvg helpers, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own inline filter instead of sharing the selection.

duplication.why: The 'include hidden' override is written twice, once in getBulkBudgetCategories' SQL and once in copyPreviousMonth's inline check, and the same inline argument type is repeated across six signatures.

placement.why: Changes stay in budget/actions.ts at the existing selection points, though the hidden rule remains split between SQL and a per-action check.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, their selection helper and one focused test are touched.

maintainability.why: The rule now carries a flag in two separately maintained places, and the repeated one-line inline types are hard to read; a shared options type and a single selection predicate would be easier to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The actions that already used getBulkBudgetCategories keep using it; copyPreviousMonth's separate filter predates the change.

disguised_duplication.where: The same hidden-category override appears as a SQL clause '(? = 1 OR (c.hidden = 0 AND g.hidden = 0))' in getBulkBudgetCategories and as a JS condition in copyPreviousMonth, i.e. one rule reshaped into two forms.
